provenance: Actual Electron renderer from out/renderer of the checkout this script ran in; synthetic sessions, git and review services; no real agent calls
checks: the rail states the verdict as "Needs review · 1 of 5 files" with its diff stat, its counts and the rule in words
three scopes are counted, and the branch scope lists the test file first in review order
a test file's header carries its alarms with their lines and says "changed outside edit tools", never "not the agent"
Approve sends the session id, the path and the state; main computes the hash
an approval made on an older version of a file shows "changed since you marked it", beside its high tier
a changed PNG shows before and after side by side, both decoded from data URLs
under the diff, Dependencies lists the added and upgraded packages with the install command, and Claims grades each claim with its reason
a note left unsent survives a move to another file and comes back with its text when the operator returns
cancelling a written note asks before discarding it
Send review puts one message with the comment and the new dependency into the message box, and sends nothing
the agent-edits scope previews the session's hunks with the refused file and its reason, and stages with the previewed digest
each turn row carries its +N −M badge from the checkpoints
a Fleet row carries "Needs review · 1 of 5 files" and its diff stat; a fully approved session shows only its stat
the Git view lists agent worktrees with their review state and diff size, sorted by size, with merge disabled while a high-tier file is unapproved
the risk tier editor shows the project's rules and offers the defaults as unsaved rows, never applying them
create PR on a worktree opens the dialog for that branch with a body written from recorded evidence, and says so
a verify task shows its saved test command and the last regression proof: proved, with both exit codes and durations
